$comment: No Content-Security-Policy here on purpose. The page carries its own CSP, built from VITE_API_URL at build time (see vite.config.js). A browser given two policies enforces both, so a static connect-src 'self' here would win the intersection and block the room API no matter what the page allows. frame-ancestors cannot be set from a meta tag, which is why X-Frame-Options below still matters.
